column21: A long spin-up in which basal sliding coefficients are adjusted to nudge thickness and surface elevation toward observations: Hybrid by rule D1. Forced with a bias-corrected RegCM3 climatology and modern observed ocean temperatures
column22: DP16 states only that "Basal sliding coefficients are determined by an inverse method".
